_standby_truncate_state_to_now: Truncate open-ended Absent intervals to 'now' when a Standby period applies
_besteffort_truncate_job_to_now: Hide the future portion of besteffort jobs so they don't extend past now
_min_state_duration: Minimum interval duration in seconds before it is drawn (0 = always draw)
_default_timespan: Initial Gantt horizontal window width in seconds (21600 = 6 h)
_job_color_min: Minimum RGB component for random job colors (0–255). 0 = full range, 255 = white. 70–140 recommended for dark/light balance.
_gantt_row_height: Default row height in pixels on first load
_gantt_row_height_min: Minimum row height reachable by vertical zoom (Alt+scroll)
_gantt_row_height_max: Maximum row height reachable by vertical zoom (Alt+scroll)
_energy_panel_height: Default height of the energy diagram panel in pixels
_energy_watts_per_resource: Estimated watts per assigned resource used when no measured energy file is loaded
_energy_series_colors: Color palette (hex) for multi-series energy lines. Cycles if more series than entries.
_now_line_color: Color of the vertical 'now' marker line on the energy plot
_zoom_max_seconds: Maximum number of seconds visible in the Gantt window (zoom-out limit). 172800 = 2 days.
_zoom_min_seconds: Minimum number of seconds visible in the Gantt window (zoom-in limit)
_scroll_zoom_sensitivity: Horizontal zoom speed for Ctrl+scroll. Higher = faster zoom.
_drag_zoom_sensitivity: Horizontal zoom speed for right-click drag. Higher = faster zoom.
_zoom_animation_duration: Duration in seconds of the 'Center on now' zoom animation
_gutter_max_width: Maximum width in pixels of the resource-label column on the left
_job_label_min_width: Minimum job bar width in pixels before the job ID label is hidden
_hatch_spacing: Spacing in pixels between diagonal lines in dead/absent interval overlays
_live_window_hours_before: How many hours before now to load when switching to the Live Data tab
_live_window_hours_after: How many hours after now to load when switching to the Live Data tab
_state_colors: Hatch overlay colors for each resource state in dark mode (hex)
_state_colors_light: Hatch overlay colors for each resource state in light mode (hex, darker for visibility)
